title: SeeDream 5.0 Pro
description: ByteDance SeeDream 5.0 Pro — precise image editing with full layer control. Text-to-image, instruction-based editing, and multi-reference composition from up to 9 reference images with 1K/2K output. Billing: 55 credits per image at 1K, 110 at 2K; input images bill 5 credits each after the first (first is free). No grouped/sequential generation.

prompt.description: Text description of the image to generate.

reference_images.description: Optional reference images (up to 9) for image editing and multi-reference composition. Each item is a public image URL, a data URI, raw base64, or an uploaded-file URL from POST /v1/uploads. Omit for text-to-image. The first input image is free; each additional one bills 5 credits per generated image.

size.description: Output resolution. 1K bills 55 credits per image; 2K bills 110.
